options.content:
Primary question: what is broken now, and where should the operator drill down first?
Scope: pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, selected Grafana time range.
Reading guide: current-status rows marked UNKNOWN mean no recent signal in the selected scope; unexpected blank current-status tables indicate a projection regression, not healthy state.

panels.title: System Status
panels.description: Current L0 operator state. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). CRIT means runtime, DQ, control-plane, workflow, or gold signals are failing for the selected pipeline/run_type. WARN means non-fatal DQ or pending-gold conditions. Next action: follow the route shown in Next Action, then open the matching panel-level drilldown.

panels.title: Next Action
panels.description: Action route projection for the selected pipeline/run_type. If the panel resolves to `NO_ROUTE`, validate that `bioetl_overview_pipeline_run_type_universe` exists for the selected pipeline/run_type combination. The row exposes `action_target`, `action_reason`, and `action_dashboard_uid`; Runtime > Control Plane > Gold Lifecycle > DQ > Provider > Workflow > Monitor. Use the panel link whose title matches the routed target. Provider route fail-closes to `provider=unknown` while preserving `pipeline_context`; workflow handoff resets scope because the workflow dashboard does not accept pipeline/run_type variables.

panels.title: L0 Inputs
panels.description: Compact L0 input summary for the selected pipeline/run_type scope. Each row keeps the worst current status for one operator input (Runtime, DQ, Gold, Control Plane, Provider, Workflow) so the landing row fits without scroll. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Use the panel links to open the matching drilldown; Workflow resets scope on handoff.

panels.title: Runtime Blockers
panels.description: Compact current runtime blocker summary. Each row keeps the worst current status per pipeline across the selected run_type scope so the first-screen table stays readable without scroll. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Open Runtime for exact blocker condition rows.

panels.title: DQ Status
panels.description: Compact current DQ summary. Each row keeps the worst current status per pipeline across the selected run_type scope so the first-screen table stays readable without scroll. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null).

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle
panels.description: Compact current gold lifecycle summary. Each row keeps the worst lifecycle status per pipeline across the selected run_type scope so the first-screen table stays readable without scroll. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Open Runtime for the exact lifecycle-state breakdown.

panels.title: Control Plane
panels.description: Compact current control-plane summary for manifest, ledger, checkpoint, and lineage guardrails. Each row keeps the worst current status per pipeline across the selected run_type scope. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Open Control Plane for the exact failing contract.

panels.title: Provider Global
panels.description: GLOBAL provider scope across pipelines. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). This panel intentionally ignores selected pipeline/run_type filters. Open Provider Health fail-closes to provider=unknown and preserves pipeline_context for return navigation.

panels.title: Workflow Selected
panels.description: Compact selected-scope workflow summary. Each row keeps the worst current workflow status per pipeline across the selected run_type scope so the first-screen table stays readable without scroll. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Open Workflow resets scope because the workflow dashboard does not accept pipeline/run_type variables.

panels.title: Workflow Global
panels.description: Compact GLOBAL workflow scope across pipelines. Each row keeps the worst current workflow status per pipeline so the first-screen table stays readable without scroll. Status values are OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null).

panels.title: Runtime Blockers Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of runtime blocker status. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Click on Runtime for detailed blocker conditions.

panels.title: DQ Status Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of DQ status. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Click on Data Quality for detailed DQ conditions.

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of gold lifecycle status. Shows OK (0), WARN (1), CRIT (2), or UNKNOWN (3/null). Disabled Gold stage returns OK as a valid non-error state.

panels.title: Historical Failures
panels.description: Historical evidence only. Keeps `pipeline` and `run_type` labels from the active Grafana window.

panels.title: Recent Terminal Runs
panels.description: Historical terminal-run evidence only. Shows non-success terminal statuses grouped by pipeline so the evidence table stays readable without scroll while preserving the active Grafana time window.

panels.title: Silver Rejects + Rate
panels.description: Selected-range Silver filter reject count and ratio against Bronze records. Evidence only; current DQ incident state lives in Data Quality.

options.content:
Raw metric starting points for this dashboard are
System Status: bioetl_l0_status{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Next Action: bioetl_l0_next_action_route{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Input Status: bioetl_l0_input_status_selected{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"}.
Exact blocker reasons live in the Control Plane, Runtime, Data Quality, Provider Health, and Workflow dashboards.
Historical evidence stays in the row above.
